questions.explanation: ASD is NOT part of TOF; TOF = VSD + overriding aorta + pulmonary stenosis + RVH.

questions.question: Best bedside intervention to prevent Ventilator-Associated Pneumonia (VAP):
questions.explanation: Semi-Fowler 30–45° is a core VAP-bundle element — reduces gastric reflux and aspiration.

explanations.B: Semi-Fowler 30–45° is a core VAP-bundle element — reduces gastric reflux and aspiration.
explanations.C: Deep sedation delays extubation and increases VAP risk.
explanations.D: Paralytics have no routine VAP-prevention role.

questions.question: Coombs test is used to diagnose:
questions.explanation: Direct Coombs detects antibody coating RBCs — classic test for AIHA.

explanations.A: Hemophilia is diagnosed with factor assays.
explanations.B: Direct Coombs detects antibody coating RBCs — classic test for AIHA.
explanations.C: G6PD is assessed with enzyme assays, not Coombs.
explanations.D: Aplastic anemia is diagnosed by bone marrow biopsy.
